.github/workflows/ci.yml:rust:Validate b.name: Validate bounded Phase 2 delivery and resource workflows
.github/workflows/ci.yml:rust:Validate b.run:
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_ci_rust_artifacts tools.tests.test_phase2_resource_binaries
fixture_root="$(mktemp -d "${RUNNER_TEMP}/lsf-operator-fixture.XXXXXXXX")"
mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/phase2-gate"
trap 'rm -rf -- "$fixture_root"' EXIT
LSF_OPERATOR_FIXTURE_ROOT="${fixture_root}/inputs" python3 tools/ci_rust_artifacts.py --inventory "$RUNNER_TEMP/lsf-workspace-tests.jsonl" --suite operator-fixture
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_phase2_operator_workflow tools.tests.test_phase2_operator_canary tools.tests.test_phase2_offline_workflow
python3 tools/run_phase2_operator_workflow.py --cli "${PWD}/target/debug/latent" --node "${PWD}/target/debug/latentd" --fixture-root "${fixture_root}/inputs" --source-commit "${GITHUB_SHA}" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/phase2-gate/operator-receipt.json"
# The executable is authenticated and hashed again in the child. Keep
# debug sections out of this bounded runtime fixture without rebuilding
# the workspace or modifying Cargo's cached executable.
objcopy --strip-debug "${PWD}/target/debug/latent-aot-compiler" "${fixture_root}/latent-aot-compiler"
stat --format='AOT compiler fixture: %s bytes' "${fixture_root}/latent-aot-compiler"
LSF_OPERATOR_FIXTURE_ROOT="${fixture_root}/inputs" LSF_AOT_COMPILER="${fixture_root}/latent-aot-compiler" python3 tools/ci_rust_artifacts.py --inventory "$RUNNER_TEMP/lsf-workspace-tests.jsonl" --suite trust-currentness
python3 tools/run_security_profile_workflow.py --cli "${PWD}/target/debug/latent" --node "${PWD}/target/debug/latentd" --compiler "${fixture_root}/latent-aot-compiler" --fixture-root "${fixture_root}/inputs" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/phase2-gate/security-profile-receipt.json"
python3 tools/run_phase2_offline_workflow.py --cli "${PWD}/target/debug/latent" --node "${PWD}/target/debug/latentd" --fixture-root "${fixture_root}/inputs" --source-commit "${GITHUB_SHA}" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/phase2-gate/offline-receipt.json"
LSF_OPERATOR_FIXTURE_ROOT="${fixture_root}/publication-inputs" python3 tools/ci_rust_artifacts.py --inventory "$RUNNER_TEMP/lsf-workspace-tests.jsonl" --suite publication-fixture
python3 tools/run_publication_workflow.py --cli "${PWD}/target/debug/latent" --node "${PWD}/target/debug/latentd" --fixture-root "${fixture_root}/publication-inputs" --source-commit "${GITHUB_SHA}" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/phase2-gate/publication-receipt.json"
# Keep the frozen 512 MiB executable-hash limit without modifying
# Cargo's debug artifacts or their hard-linked copies. Hash and run
# these same runtime-only copies, never the unstripped originals.
resource_bin="${fixture_root}/resource-bin"
mkdir "${resource_bin}"
for binary in latent latentd; do
  objcopy --strip-debug "${PWD}/target/debug/${binary}" "${resource_bin}/${binary}"
  stat --format="Resource ${binary} fixture: %s bytes" "${resource_bin}/${binary}"
done
LSF_PHASE2_RESOURCE_FIXTURE_ROOT="${fixture_root}/resource-inputs" python3 tools/ci_rust_artifacts.py --inventory "$RUNNER_TEMP/lsf-workspace-tests.jsonl" --suite resource-fixture
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_phase2_gate_resource tools.tests.test_phase2_resource_clock
LSF_GATE_FIXTURE_ROOT="${fixture_root}" python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
binaries = pathlib.Path(os.environ["LSF_GATE_FIXTURE_ROOT"]) / "resource-bin"
def digest(path):
    with path.open("rb") as source:
        return "sha256:" + hashlib.file_digest(source, "sha256").hexdigest()
identity = {
    "schemaVersion": "latent.phase2.resource-build.v1",
    "sourceRevision": os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"],
    "cargoLockSha256": digest(root / "Cargo.lock"),
    "cliSha256": digest(binaries / "latent"),
    "nodeSha256": digest(binaries / "latentd"),
    "rustcVersion": subprocess.check_output(["rustc", "--version"], text=True).strip(),
    "buildProfile": "debug",
}
(pathlib.Path(os.environ["LSF_GATE_FIXTURE_ROOT"]) / "build.json").write_text(json.dumps(identity))
PY
python3 tools/phase2_gate_resource.py --cli "${resource_bin}/latent" --node "${resource_bin}/latentd" --fixture-root "${fixture_root}/resource-inputs" --build-identity "${fixture_root}/build.json" --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/phase2-gate/resource-receipt.json"
python3 tools/phase2_gate_resource.py --validate "${RUNNER_TEMP}/phase2-gate/resource-receipt.json"

.github/workflows/ci.yml:rust:clippy.name: clippy
.github/workflows/ci.yml:rust:clippy.run:
status=0
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked > "$RUNNER_TEMP/lsf-clippy.log" 2>&1 || status=$?
if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then
  cargo clippy -p latent -p latentd -p latent-testkit -p latent-admission --all-targets --all-features --locked --no-deps -- -D warnings >> "$RUNNER_TEMP/lsf-clippy.log" 2>&1 || status=$?
fi
tail -n 120 "$RUNNER_TEMP/lsf-clippy.log"
python3 - <<'PY'
import os
import pathlib
import re
lines = (pathlib.Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "lsf-clippy.log").read_text().splitlines()
errors = [" ".join(lines[i:i + 4]) for i, line in enumerate(lines) if re.match(r"^error(?:\[.*?\])?:", line)]
diagnostic = " | ".join(errors)[:1000] or "no compiler errors"
with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a", encoding="utf-8") as output:
    output.write(f"diagnostic={diagnostic}\n")
PY
exit "$status"
